newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki plans 15 mln new shares issue.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki plans 15 mln new shares issue.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Friday it would propose to its annual general meeting on March 25 that its board be authorised to issue up to 15.0 million new K-series shares.
Currently, Rautaruukki's share capital is 1.20 billion markka and the number of shares is 120.23 million.

The Finnish state, which owns 68.66 percent of Rautaruukki, said on January 21 that SBC Warburg and Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) had been appointed as advisers on a potential further privatisation of Rautaruukki.

"The company has not, and according to the company's knowledge the Finnish state has not, made any decisions on the issue. Possible measures will be considered with the advisers," Rautaruukki said on Friday.
If the 15 million new shares issue were subscribed in full and the state did not participate in the issue, the state's ownership would fall to 61.04 percent, Rautaruukki said.
The government has been authorised by parliament to reduce the state's holding to 33.4 percent.
